rationale: Retire Amber Infrastructure's unsupported active ownership period and mark Future Energy Park realized in the PortCo database. Green Impact Partners' February 2023 announcement described a conditional strategic agreement under which Amber was expected to invest in 50% of Future Energy Park. GIP's first-quarter 2023 financial statements state that FEP LP's Class A units remained 100% held by GIP and that Amber's expected 50% interest was subject to definitive documents, project debt financing, return thresholds and other conditions. Only the separate GreenGas Colorado transaction closed. In June 2025 GIP announced a non-binding lead-equity term sheet with a different, unnamed global Japanese investment partner, and in January 2026 said Future Energy Park was still working toward financial close. No official evidence was found that Amber's conditional Future Energy Park investment ever closed. The retired period therefore records a proposed 50% interest that did not close and retains a null exit year; this is an administrative correction of erroneous active ownership, not a historical divestiture. This corrected proposal preserves all existing shared Source identities after protected workflow run 30975503065 rejected the prior attempt before any database write.

beforeImage.description: Future Energy Park is a proposed low-carbon fuels project in Calgary, Alberta centered on renewable natural gas and ethanol production. The project is being developed to serve transportation fuel and industrial decarbonization markets through an asset-heavy processing and logistics model. Public materials describe the development as one of Green Impact Partners' flagship projects and a major capital program in western Canada. Amber agreed in 2023 to acquire a 50% project-level equity interest as part of a broader partnership with Green Impact Partners. The project remained in development in reviewed public materials, with permitting and commercial workstreams continuing after the partnership announcement.

milestones.event: Amber agreed to acquire a 50% equity interest in Future Energy Park through its partnership with Green Impact Partners.
Public materials indicated the project had received Alberta environmental approval to proceed with development work.

afterImage.description: Future Energy Park is a proposed low-carbon fuels development in Calgary, Alberta, led by Green Impact Partners. In February 2023 GIP announced a conditional strategic agreement under which Amber Infrastructure was expected to invest in 50% of the project. GIP's first-quarter 2023 financial statements said FEP LP's Class A units remained 100% held by GIP and that Amber's expected interest was subject to definitive documents, project financing and other conditions. In June 2025 GIP announced a non-binding lead-equity term sheet with a different, unnamed global Japanese investment partner, and in January 2026 reported that the project was still working toward financial close. No official evidence was found that Amber's conditional Future Energy Park investment closed, so Amber is not represented as a current owner.
